ayahs.1: Paak hai woh Allah Taala jo apne bande ko raat hi raat mein Masjid-e-Haraam se Masjid-e-Aqsa tak le gaya jis ke aas paas hum ne barkat de rakhi hai, is liye ke hum use apni qudrat ke baaz namoone dikhaayen, yaqeenan Allah Taala hi khoob sunne dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.2: Hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di aur use Bani Israeel ke liye hidayat bana diya ke tum mere siwa kisi ko apna kaarsaaz na banana.
ayahs.3: Aye un logon ki aulaad! Jinhen hum ne Nooh ke saath sawaar kardiya tha, woh hamara bada hi shukr-guzaar banda tha.
ayahs.4: Hum ne Bani Israeel ke liye un ki kitaab mein saaf faisla kardiya tha ke tum zameen mein do baar fasaad barpa karoge aur tum badi zabardast ziyaadatiyan karoge.
ayahs.5: In donon waadon mein se pehle ke aate hi hum ne tumhare muqable par apne bande bhej diye jo bade hi ladaake the. Pas woh tumhare gharon ke andar tak phail gaye aur Allah ka yeh wada poora hona hi tha.
ayahs.6: Phir hum ne un par tumhara ghalba de kar tumhare din phere aur maal aur aulaad se tumhari madad ki aur tumhein bade jatthe wala bana diya.
ayahs.7: Agar tum ne achche kaam kiye to khud apne hi faaide ke liye, aur agar tum ne buraiyan kin to bhi apne hi liye, phir jab doosre wade ka waqt aaya (to hum ne doosre bandon ko bhej diya taake) woh tumhare chehre bigaad den aur pehli dafa ki tarah phir usi masjid mein ghus jaayen. Aur jis jis cheez par qaabu paayen tod phod kar jad se ukhaad den.
ayahs.8: Ummeed hai ke tumhara Rabb tum par reham kare. Haan agar tum phir bhi wahi karne lage to hum bhi dobaara aisa hi karenge aur hum ne munkiron ka qaid-khana jahannam ko bana rakha hai.
ayahs.9: Yaqeenan yeh Quran woh raasta dikhaata hai jo bahut hi seedha hai aur imaan walon ko jo nek aamaal karte hain is baat ki khushkhabri deta hai ke un ke liye bahut bada ajr hai.
ayahs.10: Aur yeh ke jo log aakhirat par yaqeen nahi rakhte un ke liye hum ne dardnaak azaab taiyaar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.11: Aur insaan buraai ki duaayen maangne lagta hai bilkul us ki apni bhalaai ki dua ki tarah, insaan hai hi bada jald-baaz.
ayahs.12: Hum ne raat aur din ko apni qudrat ki nishaaniyan banaayi hain, raat ki nishani ko to hum ne be-noor kardiya hai aur din ki nishani ko roshan banaaya hai taake tum apne Rabb ka fazl talaash kar sako aur is liye bhi ke barson ka shumaar aur hisaab maloom karsako aur har har cheez ko hum ne khoob tafseel se bayan farma diya hai.
ayahs.13: Hum ne har insaan ki buraai bhalaai ko us ke gale laga diya hai aur ba-roz-e-qayamat hum us ke saamne us ka naama-e-aamaal nikaalenge jise woh apne oopar khula hua paayega.
ayahs.14: Le! Khud hi apni kitaab aap padh le. Aaj tu khud hi apna hisaab lene ko kaafi hai.
ayahs.15: Jo raah-e-raast haasil karle woh khud apne hi bhale ke liye raah-yaafta hota hai aur jo bhatak jaaye us ka bojh usi ke oopar hai, koi bojh wala kisi aur ka bojh apne oopar na laadega aur hamari sunnat nahi ke Rasool bhejne se pehle hi azaab karne lagen.
ayahs.16: Aur jab hum kisi basti ki halaakat ka irada karlete hain to wahaan ke khushhaal logon ko (kuchh) hukm dete hain aur woh us basti mein khuli nafarmaani karne lagte hain to un par (azaab ki) baat saabit hojaati hai phir hum use tabaah-o-barbaad kardete hain.
ayahs.17: Hum ne Nooh ke baad bhi bahut si qaumen halaak kin aur tera Rabb apne bandon ke gunahon se kaafi khabardaar aur khoob dekhne bhaalne wala hai.
ayahs.18: Jis ka irada sirf is jaldi wali dunya (fauri faaida) ka hi ho use hum yahaan jis qadar jis ke liye chaahen sar-dast dete hain bil-aakhir us ke liye hum jahannam muqarrar kardete hain jahaan woh bure haalon dhutkaara hua daakhil hoga.
ayahs.19: Aur jis ka irada aakhirat ka ho aur jaisi koshish us ke liye honi chaahiye, woh karta bhi ho aur woh ba-imaan bhi ho, pas yehi log hain jin ki koshish ki Allah ke haan poori qadardaani ki jaayegi.
ayahs.20: Har ek ko hum baham pahunchaaye jaate hain unhen bhi aur unhen bhi tere parwardigar ke inaamaat mein se. Tere parwardigar ki bakhshish ruki hui nahi hai.
ayahs.21: Dekh le ke in mein ek ko ek par hum ne kis tarah fazeelat de rakhi hai aur aakhirat to darjon mein aur bhi badh kar hai aur fazeelat ke eitbaar se bhi bahut badi hai.
ayahs.22: Allah ke saath kisi aur ko mabood na thehra ke aakhirish tu bure haalon be-kas ho kar baith rahega.
ayahs.23: Aur tera parwardigar saaf saaf hukm de chuka hai ke tum is ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat na karna aur maa baap ke saath ehsaan karna. Agar teri maujoodgi mein in mein se ek ya yeh donon budhaape ko pahunch jaayen to un ke aage uff tak na kehna, na unhen daant-dapat karna balke un ke saath adab-o-ehtiraam se baat cheet karna.
ayahs.24: Aur aajizi aur mohabbat ke saath un ke saamne tawaazo ka baazu past rakhe rakhna aur dua karte rehna ke aye mere parwardigar! Un par waisa hi reham kar jaisa unhon ne mere bachpan mein meri parwarish ki hai.
ayahs.25: Jo kuchh tumhare dilon mein hai use tumhara Rabb ba-khoobi jaanta hai agar tum nek ho to woh to rujoo karne walon ko bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.26: Aur rishte-daaron ka aur miskeenon aur musaafiron ka haq ada karte raho aur israaf aur be-ja kharch se bacho.
ayahs.27: Be-ja kharch karne wale shaitaanon ke bhai hain. Aur shaitan apne parwardigar ka bada hi na-shukra hai.
ayahs.28: Aur agar tujhe un se munh pher lena pade apne Rabb ki us rahmat ki justajoo mein, jis ki tu ummeed rakhta hai to bhi tujhe chaahiye ke umdagi aur narmi se unhen samjha de.
ayahs.29: Apna haath apni gardan se bandha hua na rakh aur na use bilkul hi khol de ke phir malaamat kiya hua darmaanda baith jaaye.
ayahs.30: Yaqeenan tera Rabb jis ke liye chaahe rozi kushaada kardeta hai aur jis ke liye chaahe tang. Yaqeenan woh apne bandon se ba-khabar aur khoob dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.31: Aur muflisi ke khauf se apni aulaad ko na maar daalo, in ko aur tum ko hum hi rozi dete hain. Yaqeenan in ka qatl karna kabeera gunaah hai.
ayahs.32: Khabardaar zina ke qareeb bhi na phatakna kyunke woh badi be-hayaai hai aur bahut hi buri raah hai.
ayahs.33: Aur kisi jaan ko jis ka maarna Allah ne haraam kardiya hai hargiz naahaq qatl na karna aur jo shakhs mazloom hone ki soorat mein maar daala jaaye hum ne us ke waaris ko taaqat de rakhi hai pas use chaahiye ke maar daalne mein ziyaadati na kare be-shak woh madad kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.34: Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb bhi na jaao ba-juz is tareeqe ke jo bahut hi behtar ho, yahaan tak ke woh apni bulooghat ko pahunch jaaye aur waade poore karo kyunke qaul-o-qaraar ki baaz-purs hone wali hai.
ayahs.35: Aur jab naapne lago to bharpoor paimaane se naapo aur seedhi taraazu se tola karo. Yehi behtar hai aur anjaam ke lihaaz se bhi bahut achha hai.
ayahs.36: Jis baat ki tujhe khabar hi na ho us ke peechhe mat pad. Kyunke kaan aur aankh aur dil in mein se har ek se poochh-gachh ki jaane wali hai.
ayahs.37: Aur zameen mein akad kar na chal ke na to zameen ko phaad sakta hai aur na lambaai mein pahaadon ko pahunch sakta hai.
ayahs.38: In sab kaamon ki buraai tere Rabb ke nazdeek (sakht) na-pasand hai.
ayahs.39: Yeh bhi minjumla is wahi ke hai jo teri jaanib tere Rabb ne hikmat se utaari hai to Allah ke saath kisi aur ko mabood na banana ke malaamat-khurda aur raanda-e-dargaah ho kar dozakh mein daal diya jaaye.
ayahs.40: Kya beton ke liye to Allah ne tumhein chhaant liya aur khud apne liye farishton ko ladkiyan banaliin? Be-shak tum bahut bada bol bol rahe ho.
ayahs.41: Hum ne to is Quran mein har har tarah bayan farma diya ke log samajh jaayen lekin is se unhen to nafrat hi badhti hai.
ayahs.42: Keh dijiye! Ke agar Allah ke saath aur mabood bhi hote jaise ke yeh log kehte hain to zaroor woh ab tak Maalik-e-Arsh ki jaanib raah dhoond nikaalte.
ayahs.43: Jo kuchh yeh kehte hain us se woh paak aur baalatar, bahut door aur bahut buland hai.
ayahs.44: Saaton aasman aur zameen aur jo bhi in mein hai usi ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain. Aisi koi cheez nahi jo use paakeezgi aur tareef ke saath yaad na karti ho. Haan yeh saheeh hai ke tum us ki tasbeeh samajh nahi sakte. Woh bada burdbaar aur bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.45: Tu jab Quran padhta hai hum tere aur un logon ke darmiyan jo aakhirat par yaqeen nahi rakhte ek posheeda hijaab daal dete hain.
ayahs.46: Aur un ke dilon par hum ne parde daal diye hain ke woh use samjhein aur un ke kaanon mein bojh, aur jab tu sirf Allah hi ka zikr us ki tauheed ke saath, is Quran mein karta hai to woh rogardaani karte peeth pher kar bhaag khade hote hain.
ayahs.47: Jis gharaz se woh log use sunte hain un (ki niyaton) se hum khoob aagah hain, jab yeh aap ki taraf kaan lagaaye hue hote hain tab bhi aur jab yeh mashwara karte hain tab bhi jab ke yeh zaalim kehte hain ke tum us ki taabedaari mein lage hue ho jin par jaadu kardiya gaya hai.
ayahs.48: Dekhein to sahi, aap ke liye kya kya misaalen bayan karte hain, pas woh bahak rahe hain. Ab to raah paana un ke bas mein nahi raha.
ayahs.49: Unhon ne kaha kya jab hum haddiyan aur (mitti ho kar) reza reza hojaayenge to kya hum az-sar-e-nau paida kar ke phir dobaara utha kar khade kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.50: Jawab dijiye ke tum patthar ban jaao ya loha.
ayahs.51: Ya koi aur aisi khilqat jo tumhare dilon mein bahut hi sakht maloom ho, phir woh poochhein ke kaun hai jo dobaara hamari zindagi lautaaye? Aap jawab de den ke wahi Allah jis ne tumhein awwal baar paida kiya, is par woh apne sar hila hila kar aap se daryaaft karenge ke achha yeh hai kab? To aap jawab de den ke kya ajab ke woh (saa'at) qareeb hi aan lagi ho.
ayahs.52: Jis din woh tumhein bulaayega tum us ki tareef karte hue tameel-e-irshaad karoge aur gumaan karoge ke tumhara rehna bahut hi thoda hai.
ayahs.53: Aur mere bandon se keh dijiye ke woh bahut hi achhi baat munh se nikaala karen kyunke shaitan aapas mein fasaad dilwaata hai. Be-shak shaitan insaan ka khula dushman hai.
ayahs.54: Tumhara Rabb tum se ba-nisbat tumhare bahut ziyaada jaanne wala hai, woh agar chahe to tum par reham karde ya agar woh chahe tumhein azaab de. Hum ne aap ko in ka zimma-daar thehra kar nahi bheja.
ayahs.55: Aasmanon-o-zameen mein jo bhi hai aap ka Rabb sab ko ba-khoobi jaanta hai. Hum ne baaz paighambaron ko baaz par behtari aur bartari di hai aur Daaood ko Zaboor hum ne ata farmaayi hai.
ayahs.56: Keh dijiye ke Allah ke siwa jinhen tum mabood samajh rahe ho unhen pukaaro lekin na to woh tum se kisi takleef ko door karsakte hain aur na badal sakte hain.
ayahs.57: Jinhen yeh log pukaarte hain khud woh apne Rabb ke taqarrub ki justajoo mein rehte hain ke in mein se kaun ziyaada nazdeek hojaaye, woh khud us ki rahmat ki ummeed rakhte aur us ke azaab se khaufzada rehte hain, (baat bhi yehi hai) ke tere Rabb ka azaab darne ki cheez hi hai.
ayahs.58: Jitni bhi bastiyan hain hum qayamat ke din se pehle pehle ya to unhen halaak kardene wale hain ya sakht-tar saza dene wale hain. Yeh to kitaab mein likha ja chuka hai.
ayahs.59: Hamein nishaanaat (mojizaat) ke naazil karne se rok sirf isi ki hai ke agle log unhen jhutla chuke hain. Hum ne Samoodiyon ko ba-taur-e-baseerat ke ontni di lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, hum to logon ko dhamkaane ke liye hi nishaaniyan bhejte hain.
ayahs.60: Aur yaad karo jab ke hum ne aap se farma diya ke aap ke Rabb ne logon ko gher liya hai. Jo roya (aini rooyat) hum ne aap ko dikhaayi thi woh logon ke liye saaf aazmaaish hi thi aur isi tarah woh darakht bhi jis se Quran mein izhaar-e-nafrat kiya gaya hai. Hum unhen dara rahe hain lekin yeh unhen aur badi sarkashi mein badha raha hai.
ayahs.61: Jab hum ne farishton ko hukm diya ke Aadam ko sajda karo to Iblees ke siwa sab ne kiya, us ne kaha ke kya main use sajda karoon jise tu ne mitti se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.62: Achha dekh le, use tu ne mujh par buzurgi to di hai, lekin agar mujhe bhi qayamat tak tu ne dheel di to main is ki aulaad ko ba-juz bahut thode logon ke, apne bas mein karloonga.
ayahs.63: Irshaad hua ke ja in mein se jo bhi tera taabedaar hojaayega to tum sab ki saza jahannam hai jo poora poora badla hai.
ayahs.64: In mein se to jise bhi apni aawaaz se bahka sake bahka le aur in par apne sawaar aur piyaade chadha la aur in ke maal aur aulaad mein se apna bhi saajha laga aur unhen (jhoote) waade de le. In se jitne bhi waade shaitan ke hote hain sab ke sab saraasar fareb hain.
ayahs.65: Mere sachche bandon par tera koi qaabu aur bas nahi. Tera Rabb kaarsaazi karne wala kaafi hai.
ayahs.66: Tumhara parwardigar woh hai jo tumhare liye darya mein kashtiyan chalaata hai taake tum us ka fazl talaash karo. Woh tumhare oopar bahut hi mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.67: Aur samandron mein museebat pahunchte hi jinhen tum pukaarte the sab gum hojaate hain sirf wahi Allah baaqi reh jaata hai. Phir jab woh tumhein khushki ki taraf bacha laata hai to tum munh pher lete ho aur insaan bada hi na-shukra hai.
ayahs.68: To kya tum is se be-khauf hogaye ho ke tumhein khushki ki taraf (le ja kar zameen) mein dhansa de ya tum par pattharon ki aandhi bhej de. Phir tum apne liye kisi nigehbaan ko na paasako.
ayahs.69: Kya tum is baat se be-khauf hogaye ho ke Allah Taala phir tumhein dobaara darya ke safar mein le aaye aur tum par tez-o-tund hawaaon ke jhonke bhej de aur tumhare kufr ke baais tumhein dubo de. Phir tum apne liye hum par is ka dawa (peechha) karne wala kisi ko na paaoge.
ayahs.70: Yaqeenan hum ne aulaad-e-Aadam ko badi izzat di aur unhen khushki aur tari ki sawaariyan din aur unhen paakeeza cheezon ki roziyan din aur apni bahut si makhlooq par unhen fazeelat ata farmaayi.
ayahs.71: Jis din hum har jamaat ko us ke peshwa samet bulaayenge. Phir jin ka bhi aamaal-naama daayen haath mein de diya gaya woh to shauq se apna naama-e-aamaal padhne lagenge aur dhaage ke baraabar (zarra baraabar) bhi zulm na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.72: Aur jo koi is jahaan mein andha raha, woh aakhirat mein bhi andha aur raaste se bahut hi bhatka hua rahega.
ayahs.73: Yeh log aap ko is wahi se jo hum ne aap par utaari hai bahkaana chaahte ke aap is ke siwa kuchh aur hi hamare naam se ghad ghad lein, tab to aap ko yeh log apna wali dost bana lete.
ayahs.74: Agar hum aap ko sabit-qadam na rakhte to bahut mumkin tha ke un ki taraf qadre qaleel maail ho hi jaate.
ayahs.75: Phir to hum bhi aap ko dohra azaab dunya ka karte aur dohra hi maut ka, phir aap to apne liye hamare muqaable mein kisi ko madadgaar bhi na paate.
ayahs.76: Yeh to aap ke qadam is sar-zameen se ukhaadne hi lage the ke aap ko is se nikaal den. Phir yeh bhi aap ke baad bahut hi kam thehar paate.
ayahs.77: Aisa hi dastoor un ka tha jo aap se pehle Rasool hum ne bheje aur aap hamare dastoor mein kabhi radd-o-badal na paayenge.
ayahs.78: Namaz ko qaaim karen aftab ke dhalne se le kar raat ki taareeki tak aur fajr ka Quran padhna bhi, yaqeenan fajr ke waqt ka Quran padhna haazir kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.79: Raat ke kuchh hisse mein tahajjud ki namaz mein Quran ki tilaawat karen, yeh ziyaadati aap ke liye hai, anqareeb aap ka Rabb aap ko Maqaam-e-Mahmood mein khada karega.
ayahs.80: Aur dua kiya karen ke aye mere parwardigar mujhe jahaan le ja achhi tarah le ja aur jahaan se nikaal achhi tarah nikaal aur mere liye apne paas se ghalba aur imdaad muqarrar farma de.
ayahs.81: Aur eilaan karde ke haq aa chuka aur naahaq naabood hogaya. Yaqeenan baatil tha hi naabood hone wala.
ayahs.82: Yeh Quran jo hum naazil kar rahe hain mominon ke liye to saraasar shifa aur rahmat hai. Haan zaalimon ko ba-juz nuqsaan ke aur koi ziyaadati nahi hoti.
ayahs.83: Aur insaan par jab hum apna inaam karte hain to woh munh mod leta hai aur karwat badal leta hai aur jab use koi takleef pahunchti hai to woh maayoos hojaata hai.
ayahs.84: Keh dijiye! Ke har shakhs apne tareeqe par aamil hai, jo poori hidayat ke raaste par hain unhen tumhara Rabb hi ba-khoobi jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.85: Aur yeh log aap se rooh ki baabat sawaal karte hain, aap jawab de dijiye ke rooh mere Rabb ke hukm se hai aur tumhein bahut hi kam ilm diya gaya hai.
ayahs.86: Aur agar hum chaahen to jo wahi aap ki taraf hum ne utaari hai sab salab karlein, phir aap ko is ke liye hamare muqaable mein koi himaayati mayassar na aaske.
ayahs.87: Siwaaye aap ke Rabb ki rahmat ke, yaqeenan aap par is ka bada hi fazl hai.
ayahs.88: Keh dijiye ke agar tamaam insaan aur kull jinnat mil kar is Quran ke misl laana chaahein to un sab se is ke misl laana na-mumkin hai go woh (aapas mein) ek doosre ke madadgaar bhi ban jaayen.
ayahs.89: Hum ne to is Quran mein logon ke samajhne ke liye har tarah se tamaam misaalen bayan kardi hain, magar aksar log inkaar se baaz nahi.
ayahs.90: Unhon ne kaha ke hum aap par hargiz imaan laane ke nahi ta-waqt-ke aap hamare liye zameen se koi chashma jaari na karden.
ayahs.91: Ya khud aap ke liye hi koi baagh ho khajooron aur angooron ka aur is ke darmiyan aap bahut si nehren jaari kar dikhaayen.
ayahs.92: Ya aap aasman ko hum par tukde tukde kar ke gira den jaisa ke aap ka gumaan hai ya aap khud Allah Taala ko aur farishton ko hamare saamne la khada karen.
ayahs.93: Ya aap ke apne liye koi sone ka ghar hojaaye ya aap aasman par chadh jaayen aur hum to aap ke chadh jaane ka bhi us waqt tak hargiz yaqeen nahi karenge jab tak ke aap hum par koi kitaab na utaar laayen jise hum khud padh len, aap jawab de den ke mera parwardigar paak hai main to sirf ek insaan hi hoon jo Rasool banaaya gaya hoon.
ayahs.94: Logon ke paas hidayat pahunch chukne ke baad imaan se rokne wali sirf yehi cheez rahi ke unhon ne kaha kya Allah ne ek insaan ko hi Rasool bana kar bheja?
ayahs.95: Aap keh den ke agar zameen mein farishte chalte phirte aur rehte baste hote to hum bhi in ke paas kisi aasmaani farishte hi ko Rasool bana kar bhejte.
ayahs.96: Keh dijiye ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan Allah Taala ka gawah hona kaafi hai. Woh apne bandon se khoob aagah aur ba-khoobi dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.97: Allah jis ki rehnumaai kare to woh hidayat-yaafta hai aur jise woh raah se bhatka de na-mumkin hai ke tu us ka madadgaar us ke siwa kisi aur ko paaye, aise logon ka hum ba-roz-e-qayamat aundhe munh hashr karenge, dar-aan-haal-ke woh andhe, goonge aur behre honge, un ka thikaana jahannam hoga. Jab kabhi woh bujhne lagegi hum un par use aur bhadka denge.
ayahs.98: Yeh sab hamari aayaton se kufr karne aur is kehne ka badla hai ke kya jab hum haddiyan aur reze reze hojaayenge phir hum nayi paidaish mein utha khade kiye jaayenge?
ayahs.99: Kya unhon ne is baat par nazar nahi ki ke jis Allah ne aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya hai woh in jaison ki paidaish par poora qaadir hai, usi ne un ke liye ek aisa waqt muqarrar kar rakha hai jo shak-shubha se yaksar khaali hai, lekin zaalim log inkaar kiye baghair rehte hi nahi.
ayahs.100: Keh dijiye ke agar bil-farz tum mere Rabb ki rahmaton ke khazaanon ke maalik ban jaate to tum us waqt bhi is ke kharch hojaane ke khauf se is ko roke rakhte aur insaan hai hi tang-dil.
ayahs.101: Hum ne Moosa ko nau mojize bilkul saaf saaf ata farmaaye, tu khud hi Bani Israeel se poochh le ke jab woh in ke paas pahunche to Firaun bola ke aye Moosa mere khayaal mein to tujh par jaadu kardiya gaya hai.
ayahs.102: Moosa ne jawab diya ke yeh to tujhe ilm hochuka hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke parwardigar hi ne yeh mojize dikhaane, samjhaane ko naazil farmaaye hain, aye Firaun! Main to samajh raha hoon ke tu yaqeenan barbaad-o-halaak kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.103: Aakhir Firaun ne pukhta irada kar liya ke unhen zameen se hi ukheed de to hum ne khud use aur us ke tamaam saathiyon ko gharq kar diya.
ayahs.104: Is ke baad hum ne Bani Israeel se farma diya ke is sar-zameen par tum raho saho. Haan jab aakhirat ka wada aayega hum tum sab ko samet aur lapet kar le aayenge.
ayahs.105: Aur hum ne is Quran ko haq ke saath utaara aur yeh bhi haq ke saath utra. Hum ne aap ko sirf khushkhabri sunaane wala aur daraane wala bana kar bheja hai.
ayahs.106: Quran ko hum ne thoda thoda kar ke is liye utaara hai ke aap use ba-mohlat logon ko sunaayen aur hum ne khud bhi use ba-tadreej naazil farmaya.
ayahs.107: Keh dijiye! Tum is par imaan lao ya na lao, jinhen is se pehle ilm diya gaya hai un ke paas to jab bhi is ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to woh thodiyon ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain.
ayahs.108: Aur kehte hain ke hamara Rabb paak hai, hamare Rabb ka wada bila-shak-o-shubha poora ho kar rehne wala hi hai.
ayahs.109: Woh apni thodiyon ke bal rote hue sajde mein gir padte hain aur yeh Quran in ki aajizi aur khushoo aur khuzoo badha deta hai.
ayahs.110: Keh dijiye ke Allah ko Allah keh kar pukaaro ya Rahman keh kar, jis naam se bhi pukaaro tamaam achhe naam usi ke hain. Na to tu apni namaz bahut buland aawaaz se padh aur na bilkul posheeda balke is ke darmiyan ka raasta talaash karle.
ayahs.111: Aur yeh keh dijiye ke tamaam tareefen Allah hi ke liye hain jo na aulaad rakhta hai na apni baadshaahat mein kisi ko shareek-o-saajhi rakhta hai aur na woh kamzor hai ke use kisi himaayati ki zaroorat ho aur tu us ki poori poori badaai bayan karta reh.
